sentences.text: The Light List, published by the Coast Guard, describes every aid in its region: name and position, light characteristic, height above water, nominal range, the structure, and remarks such as sector bearings or fog signals.
Volume three covers the Atlantic and Gulf coasts from Little River, South Carolina, around Florida to the Econfina River in the Big Bend, so it includes most of Florida.
Volume four continues along the Gulf to Texas.
Check the Local Notice to Mariners for changes since the edition you’re using.
